projects.name: IdeaDen — AI-Powered Project Planning & Content Platform
projects.label: MERN Stack
projects.description: Developed a full-stack AI-powered platform that transforms ideas into structured PRDs, build-ready project documentation, and SEO-optimized content using Google Gemini AI, while providing subscription-based access through Stripe.
projects.details: IdeaDen is an AI-powered platform built with Next.js 16, Express 5, TypeScript, and MongoDB that helps developers move from a vague idea to a structured, build-ready project plan. Developers can generate personalized project ideas, transform any idea into a comprehensive 7-section PRD, and expand the PRD into five execution documents covering System Design, Site Map & User Flow, UI/UX Guidelines, Data Model, and Implementation Plan. The platform also provides an AI blog generator with customizable templates, tones, lengths, and SEO keywords. IdeaDen uses Google Gemini AI for content generation, Better Auth with JWT/JWKS for secure cross-service authentication, TanStack Query for data management, and Stripe for Pro subscriptions with webhook-based role synchronization. The frontend and backend run as separate Vercel deployments communicating through authenticated HTTP APIs.
keyContributions: Designed and developed a complete AI-powered workflow that transforms project ideas into PRDs and five build-ready technical documents
Integrated Google Gemini AI through dedicated generation services for structured project ideas, PRDs, blog content, and project documentation
Built the PRD generation system with seven structured sections covering strategy, users, requirements, design, execution, planning, and risk
Implemented incremental Project Docs generation so individual documents are persisted as they are completed, allowing partial generations to survive API timeouts
Designed a distributed Next.js and Express architecture with secure JWT-based communication and remote JWKS verification across independent Vercel deployments
Implemented Stripe Checkout, customer portal, subscription management, and webhooks to synchronize Pro and Free user roles server-side
Built usage controls with per-user generation cooldowns, daily quotas for Free users, and unlimited generation access for Pro users
Developed community discovery with full-text search, visibility and duration filtering, sorting, pagination, and related project recommendations
Created personal and administrative analytics dashboards with technology distribution, blog topic distribution, and 14-day generation activity charts using Recharts
Implemented content de-duplication to prevent generating similar ideas and content from a user's previous generations
challenges: Designing a secure authentication boundary between Better Auth on the frontend and JWT/JWKS verification on the Express backend
Building reliable multi-stage AI generation workflows where long-running Project Docs generation can partially complete and persist before a timeout
Managing AI usage limits, cooldowns, Free/Pro quotas, and subscription state across frontend, backend, and Stripe webhooks
Structuring AI-generated output into consistent PRDs and technical documentation while supporting different generation types and content formats
futurePlans: Add AI-assisted project refinement and iterative editing for generated PRDs and project documents
Introduce project workspaces for organizing ideas, PRDs, and generated documentation
Add additional AI providers and model selection for different generation requirements
Enable collaborative project planning and sharing between developers and teams

projects.name: AreaAlert — Community Incident Reporting & Public Safety Platform
projects.label: MERN Stack
projects.description: Developed a full-stack community reporting platform that enables residents to report, verify, and track utility outages through location-based reporting, interactive maps, community validation, and role-based administration.
projects.details: AreaAlert is a production-ready community reporting platform built with Next.js 16, Express 5, TypeScript, and MongoDB. The application allows residents to report electricity, internet, water, gas, and flood incidents while enabling the community to validate reports through voting and resolution confirmation. The frontend and backend are deployed as independent Vercel applications, with authentication managed by Better Auth and secured using JWT verification through a JWKS endpoint. The platform includes role-based dashboards, advanced filtering, interactive safety maps, MongoDB aggregation-based analytics, secure server actions, and a responsive user experience optimized for both desktop and mobile devices.
keyContributions: Designed a distributed architecture with separate Next.js and Express deployments communicating through authenticated REST APIs
Implemented secure authentication using Better Auth, JWT, and JWKS verification across frontend and backend services
Built a complete community reporting workflow supporting utility outage submissions, voting, and service restoration confirmation
Developed interactive safety maps with district and area visualization, filtering, and severity indicators
Created role-based administration features including user moderation, report management, and platform analytics
Implemented advanced search, filtering, pagination, and historical report analysis for efficient data discovery
Optimized backend analytics using MongoDB aggregation pipelines and the native MongoDB driver without an ORM
challenges: Designing secure authentication across independently deployed frontend and backend applications
Building scalable location-based reporting and community verification workflows
Optimizing MongoDB aggregation queries for safety statistics while maintaining responsive dashboard performance
futurePlans: Add real-time outage notifications for affected areas
Introduce AI-assisted duplicate report detection and categorization
Expand interactive mapping with live incident updates and historical trend visualization

projects.name: GestorFitness — Fitness & Gym Management Platform
projects.label: MERN Stack
projects.description: Developed a full-stack B2C fitness marketplace that connects members with certified trainers, enabling class discovery, secure bookings, trainer management, and an interactive fitness community.
projects.details: GestorFitness is a production-ready fitness marketplace built with Next.js, Express.js, MongoDB, and Better Auth. The platform supports three user roles—Member, Trainer, and Admin—each with dedicated dashboards and permissions. Members can discover classes, save favorites, and book sessions using Stripe payments. Trainers can manage classes, monitor enrollments, and publish community content, while administrators oversee users, trainer applications, class approvals, transactions, and platform moderation. The project focuses on scalable architecture, secure role-based access control, optimized database queries, and a modern user experience.

Integrated Stripe payments for secure fitness class bookings with duplicate booking prevention
Developed class discovery with search, category filtering, and favorites management
Implemented community forums with posts, comments, likes, and trainer-generated content
Designed role-based authorization using Better Auth, JWT, and reusable middleware
Built trainer application workflow with admin approval and platform moderation features
Created analytics dashboards using Recharts for trainer and administrative insights
challenges: Implementing secure role-based access control across multiple dashboards and APIs
Managing complex booking, payment, and trainer approval workflows
Optimizing MongoDB queries for real-time search, filtering, and dashboard statistics
futurePlans: Add live messaging between members and trainers
Introduce recurring subscriptions and membership plans
Implement real-time notifications and calendar synchronization

projects.name: QuietHub — Room & Workspace Booking Platform
projects.label: Practice Project
projects.description: Developed a full-stack room and workspace booking platform that allows users to browse available rooms, make reservations, manage bookings, and prevent overlapping schedules through backend validation logic.
projects.details: QuietHub is a real-world booking platform built with Next.js, Express.js, and MongoDB, focused on handling authentication workflows, booking validation systems, and scalable backend architecture. The project includes protected APIs, JWT-based authentication using Better Auth, room management, booking rescheduling, and time conflict prevention. Significant focus was placed on understanding backend structure, MongoDB aggregation pipelines, reusable middleware patterns, and handling complex date/time booking logic in practical scenarios.
keyContributions: Built JWT-based authentication system using Better Auth with protected Express.js APIs
Developed complete room management functionality including creation, editing, and deletion
Implemented booking system with reservation, rescheduling, and cancellation support
Created backend validation logic to prevent overlapping room bookings and scheduling conflicts
Integrated MongoDB aggregation pipelines to combine room and booking-related data efficiently
Designed reusable middleware and utility-based backend structure for maintainability
Implemented room search and filtering functionality for improved user experience
Built responsive frontend UI using Tailwind CSS and HeroUI components
challenges: Understanding JWT verification flow between frontend and backend systems
Preventing overlapping bookings without creating false-positive conflicts
Handling different date and time formats consistently across booking operations
Managing MongoDB ObjectId values alongside custom string-based room IDs
Learning aggregation pipelines to include room details inside booking responses
Structuring backend logic into reusable middleware and utility functions instead of route-heavy code
Handling booking count updates correctly after cancellations and rescheduling
Debugging authentication issues and protected API access
futurePlans: Add payment integration for paid reservations
Implement real-time booking updates using Socket.IO
Add admin dashboard with moderation and analytics features
Improve API validation, error handling, and backend scalability
Add automated testing for booking workflows and APIs
Enhance calendar visualization and room availability UI
